text:
This is an invitation for holders to cast ballots at the forthcoming AGM.

Professional-investor eligibility as a condition of voting is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Holders may choose Immobilisation of instructed stock; exercising votes does not depend on that choice.
Proof of ownership of the voting position is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.
A restriction requiring one direction for all votes is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Enrolment of the voting holder is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.
A signed POA from the beneficial holder is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.
Retrieval of lent shares to exercise the vote is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Submission of beneficial-owner identification is unnecessary for the current voting service.

This is an invitation for holders to cast ballots at the forthcoming AGM.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A signed POA from the beneficial holder is unnecessary for the current voting service.
A restriction requiring one direction for all votes is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Holders may choose Retrieval of lent shares to exercise the vote; exercising votes does not depend on that choice.
Holders may choose Submission of beneficial-owner identification; exercising votes does not depend on that choice.
Immobilisation of instructed stock is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Holders may choose Proof of ownership of the voting position; exercising votes does not depend on that choice.
Professional-investor eligibility as a condition of voting is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.
Enrolment of the voting holder is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.

text:
This is an invitation for holders to cast ballots at the forthcoming AGM.

A restriction requiring one direction for all votes is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Professional-investor eligibility as a condition of voting is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Holders may choose Immobilisation of instructed stock; exercising votes does not depend on that choice.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Holders may choose Proof of ownership of the voting position; exercising votes does not depend on that choice.
Submission of beneficial-owner identification is unnecessary for the current voting service.
Whether Retrieval of lent shares to exercise the vote applies to this vote has not yet been established.
Enrolment of the voting holder is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.
A signed POA from the beneficial holder is a prerequisite for valid voting instructions.
